column1: # NOTE: sharpe_methodology is required. DDBudget's reported Sharpe is milestone-aggregated and not comparable to Turtle's daily compounded equity Sharpe.
methodology: daily_equity_sharpe = compounded daily returns × √252 / std
NOTE: DDBudget uses milestone-aggregated Sharpe (mean of per-period Sharpe ratios).
This inflates the number ~7x vs true daily equity Sharpe.
Compare: DDBudget 61.3x vs Turtle 221.1x — Turtle has MORE real return but lower milestone Sharpe.
